title: Planar equality conjecture for symmetric convex bodies
statement: Let $K\subset\mathbb{R}^2$ be a convex body with a center of symmetry and containing the origin, and let $p>1$. **Planar symmetric-body equality conjecture.** Equality in the relevant symmetric-body Rogers--Shephard inequality occurs only when $K$ is a parallelogram with a vertex at the origin. This is a proposed refinement of the planar equality characterization; the supplied text gives no resolution.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03582
